title: UpsertProgramRoomBlockCallablePayload
description: Create or update reserved room inventory at a program hotel. Coordinator/manager only — hotelDesk consumes inventory but cannot define it. totalRooms may not be lowered below the block's live consuming stays.

roomBlockId.description: Existing block to update. Omit to create a new block.

expectedRevision.description: Required on updates; the write fails when the stored revision moved.

hotelId.description: Hotel the block is at. Immutable on existing blocks.

label.description: Human label for the block (e.g. "Bride family", "Floor 3").

roomType.description: Optional room class (Deluxe, Suite). Null when the block is type-agnostic.

heldForGroupIds.description: Guest groups this block is earmarked for; empty for general inventory.

startsAtMillis.description: Block window start. Required on create; omit on update to keep the stored value.

endsAtMillis.description: Block window end. Required on create; omit on update to keep the stored value.
